mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (both below their 3-month moving averages) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are declining (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), a CPIAUCSL reading above 6.0% indicates persistent inflation that necessitates further rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1%) indicate a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS growth is negative (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1400 thousand units consistently signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400 (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading below 290.0 (index 1982-1984=100) indicates decelerating inflation, reducing the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 290.0 (over a 3-year rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
